note: Masthead navigation and branding -- renders: site logo, section names, 'Sections' button, 'Search' button, 'Subscribe' link
Site index header -- renders: 'Site Index' label
Footer navigation -- renders: fixed list of site sections and legal links (e.g., 'Privacy', 'Terms', 'Contact')
Stream tab navigation -- renders: fixed tab labels (e.g., 'Latest', 'Popular')
Pagination controls -- renders: page numbers and navigation arrows
